_comment: Tier 2 validation rules (R2 7.2): checks the registry's structure cannot imply. Hand-authored. build.py merges these into logical_schemas.json, which is generated and must not be edited directly. Each rule's query returns offending rows; an empty result is a pass (R2 7.3).

core.array_dimensions.sql: SELECT array_asset_id, COUNT(*) AS n_axes, MAX(axis_index) AS max_axis FROM core_array_dimensions GROUP BY array_asset_id HAVING MAX(axis_index) <> COUNT(*) - 1 OR MIN(axis_index) <> 0

core.clocks.message: neither tick_rate_hz nor an exact rational rate is present
core.clocks.sql: SELECT clock_id FROM core_clocks WHERE tick_rate_hz IS NULL AND (tick_rate_num IS NULL OR tick_rate_den IS NULL)
SELECT clock_id, tick_rate_hz, tick_rate_num, tick_rate_den FROM core_clocks WHERE tick_rate_hz <= 0 OR tick_rate_num <= 0 OR tick_rate_den <= 0

core.clocks.message: transform_slope and transform_offset must be present together
core.clocks.sql: SELECT clock_id FROM core_clocks WHERE (transform_slope IS NULL) <> (transform_offset IS NULL)

core.clocks.message: a clock transform is declared without a parent clock
core.clocks.sql: SELECT clock_id FROM core_clocks WHERE parent_clock_id IS NULL AND transform_slope IS NOT NULL

core.clocks.message: tick_zero_utc is more than a day from session_start_time
core.clocks.sql: SELECT c.clock_id, c.tick_zero_utc, s.session_start_time FROM core_clocks c JOIN core_sessions s USING (session_id) WHERE c.tick_zero_utc IS NOT NULL AND s.session_start_time IS NOT NULL AND (c.tick_zero_utc < s.session_start_time - INTERVAL 1 DAY OR c.tick_zero_utc > s.session_start_time + INTERVAL 1 DAY)

core.processing_runs.message: a failed run is recorded in a committed packet
core.processing_runs.sql: SELECT processing_run_id, activity_type FROM core_processing_runs WHERE status = 'failed'

core.sessions.message: the manifest sessions list disagrees with core.sessions
core.sessions.sql: SELECT session_id FROM core_sessions WHERE session_id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM manifest_sessions) UNION ALL SELECT session_id FROM manifest_sessions WHERE session_id NOT IN (SELECT session_id FROM core_sessions)

core.sorting_runs.message: spikes carry amplitudes but the sorting run declares no amplitude_unit
core.sorting_runs.sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.sorting_run_id FROM core_spike_events s JOIN core_sorting_runs r USING (sorting_run_id) WHERE s.amplitude IS NOT NULL AND r.amplitude_unit IS NULL

core.spike_events.message: negative ticks on a clock with no absolute reference
core.spike_events.sql: SELECT s.session_id, s.clock_id, MIN(s.t_tick) AS min_tick FROM core_spike_events s JOIN core_clocks c USING (clock_id) WHERE s.t_tick < 0 AND c.tick_zero_utc IS NULL GROUP BY s.session_id, s.clock_id

core.trials.sql: SELECT session_id, trial_id, start_tick, stop_tick FROM core_trials WHERE stop_tick < start_tick

core.units.message: n_spikes, first_spike_tick or last_spike_tick disagrees with core.spike_events
core.units.sql: SELECT u.session_id, u.unit_id FROM core_units u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT session_id, unit_id, sorting_run_id, curation_id, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(t_tick) AS lo, MAX(t_tick) AS hi FROM core_spike_events GROUP BY session_id, unit_id, sorting_run_id, curation_id ) s USING (session_id, unit_id, sorting_run_id, curation_id) WHERE (u.n_spikes IS NOT NULL AND u.n_spikes IS DISTINCT FROM s.n) OR (u.first_spike_tick IS NOT NULL AND u.first_spike_tick IS DISTINCT FROM s.lo) OR (u.last_spike_tick IS NOT NULL AND u.last_spike_tick IS DISTINCT FROM s.hi)
